title: Cisco Webex License
description: Represents a Webex license for an organization, including total and consumed units and subscription details.

totalUnits.description: Total number of license units available.

consumedByUsers.description: Number of units consumed by users.

consumedByWorkspaces.description: Number of units consumed by workspaces.

subscriptionId.description: Subscription ID associated with the license.

siteUrl.description: Webex site URL for the license.
